Sandbox_WorkingKnowledge_SpawnRate_toolt: How often Working Knowledge documents appear in loot containers. Does not affect already-generated containers; only new ones loaded after this setting is applied.
Sandbox_WorkingKnowledge_XPGrant_tooltip: Base XP awarded when a character reads a document for the first time. Scaled by the game's passive skill rate. Set to 0 to disable XP entirely. Default: 50.
Sandbox_WorkingKnowledge_ConsumeOnRead_t: When enabled, a document is destroyed once it has been read, so it cannot be passed to another survivor. Intended for multiplayer servers that do not want a single copy training the whole group. Default: off.
